title: PBAC Course Lesson
description: Schema for a single lesson in the Policy-Based Access Control Course. Corresponds to an entry under COURSE_DATA.levels.<levelKey>.lessons.<lessonId> in course-data.js or practical-examples.js. See docs/CONTENT_MODEL.md for guidance.

id.description: Snake-case identifier unique across all lessons, e.g. 'rego_foundations', 'immuta_policies'.

title.description: Short display title in the navigation and at the top of the lesson.

level.description: The level tier the lesson belongs to.

number.description: Sequential lesson number across the whole course (1..24), no gaps.

estimatedTime.description: Estimated time to complete in minutes. Be honest. Capstones are 480 across sessions with milestones.

difficulty.description: 1 = gentle intro, 5 = research-level. Used only for display, not gating.

prerequisites.description: List of lesson IDs that must be completed before this lesson unlocks. Empty array means no prereqs.

unlocked.description: False = locked behind prereqs (the default). True = always unlocked.

content.description: Lesson body as an HTML string (rendered inside the lesson container). Use <div class="lesson-section"> blocks. May embed ${createCodeBlock(...)} or ${renderPolicyLab(...)} helpers in practical-examples.js.

concepts.description: Concept tags this lesson covers. Used by adaptive-learning reinforcement. At least one concept should be referenced by each quiz question.

passingScore.description: 0-100. MUST be reachable by the discretized scores of N questions, e.g. 60 for 5 questions (achievable scores: 0/20/40/60/80/100).

sampleSize.description: Questions sampled per attempt from a larger bank. Course convention: bank of 8, sampleSize 5, so passingScore math stays on the 5-question ladder.

questions.description: Question bank: at least 8 per quiz; sampleSize are drawn per attempt (see sampleSize).

isCorrect.description: True for the one correct option.

explanation.description: Shown in quiz review mode; explain WHY the correct answer is correct.

concept.description: A concept tag referenced by the lesson's concepts array.

type.description: Implementation key matched in pbac-animations.js drawFrame(). Adding new types requires implementing the draw method.

controls.description: List of control handler names implemented on window.animations.
